script_text: Pisces, this week cracks open a door you've prayed over for months. Monday and Tuesday, the Sun in your 9th House squares Pluto in your 12th, so hidden power plays and old anxiety surface. As a Water sign ruled by Neptune, breathe before confronting bosses or banks. Wednesday flips everything: Mercury enters Sagittarius and your 10th House of career, trining Neptune in your 2nd House of income — every pitch converts to cash. Thursday through Sunday, Venus in your 7th House of love squares Uranus in your 4th, delivering one electric, unexpected invitation; say yes before Saturday night. Meanwhile Saturn in your 2nd demands one honest budget cut. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury enters your 10th House trine Neptune. Friday is your riskiest day because Venus squares Uranus; never sign papers while angry. Journal Sunday night; Neptune rewards honest dreaming. Follow for daily updates.
